goal: Close the six current terminal G2 validity blockers with the smallest coherent descendant of the existing G2 path and one shared exact PipeWire stream-timing surface. Do not create a second Voice, turn, packet, state, effect, playback-product, analyzer or acceptance authority.

current_source_observation.runtime_behavior: Promotion-bearing playback currently uses paplay; play_start records time.monotonic_ns immediately after Popen and the cancel source offset is derived from that process-spawn timestamp.
current_source_observation.runtime_identity: runtime_identity currently records piper-tts version plus Python executable identity only.
current_source_observation.guard_behavior: Required tts_runtime_binary_sha256 is currently sha256(sys.executable); piper-tts distribution manifest is computed separately but not the canonical required runtime identity.
current_source_observation.analyzer_behavior: Terminal audio-tail math currently consumes cancel-offset-ms on the source timeline and uses fixed window scans.
current_source_observation.repository_search: No existing current helper using pw_stream_get_time_n/pw_stream_get_nsec was found by the Trigger7 repository search before this packet. Refresh before implementation.

primary_external_semantics.pw_stream_get_time_n: While a stream is running, returns a pw_time snapshot including now, graph ticks/rate, graph/device delay, stream queued data and resampler buffered data; playback total delay is represented by queued + buffered + graph/device delay in the documented timing model.
primary_external_semantics.pw_stream_get_nsec: Provides a stream time value comparable to pw_time.now.
primary_external_semantics.pw_buffer_size: For audio, use frame units for buffer size so queued stream data can be interpreted in frames.
primary_external_semantics.design_consequence: Process launch time is not sufficient source-frame identity. Terminal G2 timing should bind the exact playback stream to its own timing/queued/buffered/delay state.

reuse: existing PipeWire sink/monitor object identity and observer
existing H4 guard and canonical required-observables outer guard

control commands over a local pipe/socket only inside the disposable G2 sandbox

helper_contract.buffer_unit_rule: Set/report pw_buffer.size in audio frames where the current PipeWire API supports it; otherwise record exact unit conversion and fail closed if queued data cannot be expressed in source-frame units.
helper_contract.cancel_interface: The helper itself does not decide semantic cancellation. Python/Trigger4 observes the exact newly emitted BARGE_IN_CANCEL_PROPAGATED event for the bound packet, first takes the causally-prior timing snapshot, then sends one terminate/cancel command to this exact helper stream and records the delivery/terminal timestamps.
helper_contract.scope_fence: The helper is an instrumented G2 playback test driver. Its existence does not mint autonomous production playback executor credit.

shared_timing_solution.purpose: Close PREDECLARED_LATENCY_BOUND_CAUSALITY + CANCEL_SOURCE_TIMELINE_CAUSALITY + CANCEL_ACTIVE_AUDIO_PROOF with one exact stream timing surface.
stream_epoch: Bind exact source frame 0 to the helper's first submitted source frame and persist the exact stream epoch used for all later snapshots.
Do not equate PipeWire graph ticks directly with source-frame index unless the helper explicitly records the mapping/epoch and sample-rate conversion.

At each timing snapshot persist total source frames submitted plus pw_time queued/buffered/delay fields so current consumed/presentation-relative position can be derived under a documented fixed formula or fail closed if the relationship is ambiguous.
pre_cancel_bound: Before causal cancel, while the exact playback stream is running, capture a read-only timing snapshot from that exact stream.
Convert relevant queued + buffered + graph/device delay to milliseconds using the exact stream/sample rate and documented units.
Freeze max_inflight_ms from the observed relevant delay plus a fixed predeclared deterministic safety policy; do not derive it solely from clock.quantum/rate.
Record every term and the formula in the receipt. Missing/unparseable/ambiguous units -> EVIDENCE_INVALID_BOUND_ASSUMPTION before product-negative reasoning.
cancel_source_position: At/immediately before the exact causal cancel delivery, capture the exact stream timing snapshot and map the monotonic cancel instant to a source-frame/source-timeline position from the persisted stream epoch.
Persist mapping inputs and derived cancel_source_frame; keep old process-spawn cancel_offset_ms only as diagnostic legacy data, never terminal timing authority.
active_at_cancel: Predeclare a short immediate pre-cancel interval in source-frame space (for example 60 ms; Trigger4 may choose another fixed value before inspecting cancel outcome).

Require source-active samples in that interval and require the cancel-run monitor to correlate to the exact old source over that same mapped interval with the existing declared RMS/correlation floors.
If the mapped cancel interval is a speech pause/silence, classify EVIDENCE_INVALID_CANCEL_NOT_PROVEN_DURING_ACTIVE_OLD_AUDIO; do not move the cancel point after observing the cancel result.

For repeatability, Trigger4 may deterministically preselect a sustained-active target source region from the already-bound run-local source/control evidence before the cancel run and instruct the helper to signal when the stream reaches that mapped target.

preferred_contract_change: Add/use terminal cancel_source_frame (or exact cancel source timeline value) from the native stream timing receipt instead of interpreting paplay Popen-relative milliseconds as source position.
Keep capture alignment as independent waveform/readback identity evidence.
Compute bound_start_frame = ceil(cancel_source_frame + max_inflight_frames) exactly in sample space.
Run a dedicated post-bound-only correlation scan starting at bound_start_frame; require zero old-packet correlation in every source-active analyzable post-bound interval.
Remove observed_tail <= max_inflight + window_ms as a semantic acceptance extension. Window granularity may be reported as measurement uncertainty but cannot enlarge the frozen bound.
Add the immediate-pre-cancel active/correlated predicate using the exact mapped cancel_source_frame.
analyzer_repair.classification_rule: Unresolved source/cancel timing or boundary resolution -> EVIDENCE_INVALID. PRODUCT_NEGATIVE_OLD_PACKET_AUDIO_PERSISTS_BEYOND_DECLARED_BOUND only when exact post-bound-only evidence observes old-packet correlation after the frozen bound.

focused_regression_matrix: R1 same Python interpreter + different synthetic Piper manifest => canonical runtime identity differs
R2 missing Piper runtime/distribution identity => terminal guard rejects
R3 higher causally-prior stream queued/buffered/delay => frozen bound reflects it before cancel
R4 missing/ambiguous timing units or later timing invalidation => EVIDENCE_INVALID_BOUND_ASSUMPTION, not product-negative
R5 injected playback-process/helper startup delay with identical stream frame progression => cancel_source_frame unchanged
R6 missing exact stream/source mapping with otherwise green PCM => terminal reject
R7 fixed cancel lands in source silence but earlier alignment is green => terminal reject ACTIVE_AT_CANCEL
R8 sustained exact old-source correlation immediately before mapped cancel => ACTIVE_AT_CANCEL predicate passes
R9 old correlation only in post-bound suffix of a formerly straddling window => terminal reject
R10 changing analyzer window_ms cannot move the semantic bound
R11 synthetic harness null-sink cleanup failure => NOT_ACCEPTED + zero credit without unsupported PRODUCT_NEGATIVE
R12 all existing H1-H5, causal delivery, replacement readback, object identity, packet non-commit fence and explicit zero-credit fields remain green
